verdict.rationale: Stripe ships an official CLI to build, test, and manage integrations from the command line, and frames it as agent-ready tooling. It includes `stripe agent setup`, which auto-configures coding agents, and anonymous sandbox provisioning that docs tell coding agents to use via `npm i -g @stripe/cli`. Agent-legible companions add JSON output (`stripe directory search --format json`), Stripe Projects provisioning, and the Link CLI with `--llms-full` and `--schema`. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the CLI working in agent workflows (the probe only confirms the docs page exists).
